import NEU_EmitModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFO_ReadModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Output := NEU_EmitModel.Output
abbrev DecodeError := NEU_EmitModel.Error
abbrev Bytes := List U8
inductive Error where
  | cpi : AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError → Error
  | missing | program | data
inductive Event where
  | clear | invoke | read | decode
structure Accepted where
  value : Output
  bytes : Bytes

def run {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (cpi : core.result.Result Unit AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError)
    (returned : Option (Key × Bytes))
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError)) :
    Result (core.result.Result Accepted Error × List Event) :=
  match cpi with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.cpi e), [.clear,.invoke])
  | .Ok () =>
    match returned with
    | none => ok (.Err .missing, [.clear,.invoke,.read])
    | some (program,bytes) =>
      if program ≠ selected then ok (.Err .program, [.clear,.invoke,.read])
      else if bytes.length ≠ 792 then ok (.Err .data, [.clear,.invoke,.read])
      else do
        let decoded ← decode bytes
        match decoded with
        | .Err _ => ok (.Err .data, [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode])
        | .Ok value => ok (.Ok ⟨value,bytes⟩, [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode])

theorem cpi_error {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (e : AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError) (returned : Option (Key × Bytes))
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError)) :
    run selected (.Err e) returned decode = ok (.Err (.cpi e), [.clear,.invoke]) := rfl

theorem missing {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError)) :
    run selected (.Ok ()) none decode = ok (.Err .missing, [.clear,.invoke,.read]) := rfl

theorem wrong_program {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected program : Key)
    (bytes : Bytes) (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError))
    (different : program ≠ selected) :
    run selected (.Ok ()) (some (program,bytes)) decode =
      ok (.Err .program, [.clear,.invoke,.read]) := by
  simp only [run, if_pos different]

theorem wrong_length {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (bytes : Bytes) (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError))
    (length : bytes.length ≠ 792) :
    run selected (.Ok ()) (some (selected,bytes)) decode =
      ok (.Err .data, [.clear,.invoke,.read]) := by
  simp only [run, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, if_pos length]

theorem decoded {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (bytes : Bytes) (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError))
    (value : Output) (length : bytes.length = 792)
    (decoded : decode bytes = ok (.Ok value)) :
    run selected (.Ok ()) (some (selected,bytes)) decode =
      ok (.Ok ⟨value,bytes⟩, [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode]) := by
  simp only [run, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, length, decoded, bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms cpi_error
#print axioms missing
#print axioms wrong_program
#print axioms wrong_length
#print axioms decoded
end NFO_ReadModel

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
abbrev Statement := NEU_EmitModel.Statement
abbrev Output := NEU_EmitModel.Output
abbrev Bytes := List U8

/-- Primitive runtime interpretation, scoped to the SAME instruction context
and the exact post-write state. No intervening CPI/state is admitted here.
This is the accepted RuntimeReturnData row, not a theorem about Solana. -/
structure Runtime (Context Key State : Type) where
  write : Context → Key → Bytes → State
  read : Context → State → Option (Key × Bytes)

def RuntimeReturnData {Context Key State : Type}
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key State) : Prop :=
  ∀ context program bytes, bytes.length ≤ 1024 →
    runtime.read context (runtime.write context program bytes) = some (program,bytes)

/-- OPEN native decoder obligation. The imported coherent cohort has the
ASR8 encoder; this job must not silently invent a CLOSED decoder bridge.
This named hypothesis states the accepted-emission roundtrip required below. -/
def DecoderAssociation
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output NEU_EmitModel.Error)) : Prop :=
  ∀ s : Statement,
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ()) →
    decode (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s))

/-- Exact conditional MODEL join. The native Pool read certificate, its
call-site domain and decoder association must be supplied independently for
hybrid credit. No headline or native extraction premise is discharged here. -/
theorem association {Context Key RuntimeState Accounts Other : Type} [DecidableEq Key]
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key RuntimeState) (law : RuntimeReturnData runtime)
    (context : Context) (selected : Key)
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output NEU_EmitModel.Error))
    (decoder : DecoderAssociation decode)
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State Accounts Other) (s : Statement)
    (valid : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes))
      state s = ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set state
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) ∧
    NFO_ReadModel.run selected (.Ok ())
      (runtime.read context (runtime.write context selected
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) decode =
      ok (.Ok ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩,
        [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode]) := by
  refine ⟨AspisR1.JHb_Emit.accepted _ (fun _ _ => rfl) state s valid, ?_⟩
  have width := (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).property
  rw [law context selected _ (by rw [width]; decide)]
  exact NFO_ReadModel.decoded selected _ decode _ width (decoder s valid)

/-- The legacy ASVS length gate cannot accept NFD's SAME ASR8 bytes.
This is an interface mismatch result, never a new wire-format adoption. -/
theorem legacy_width_mismatch (s : Statement) :
    (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val.length ≠ 384 := by
  rw [(AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).property]
  decide

#print axioms association
#print axioms legacy_width_mismatch
end NFO_PoolReturnData

import NFO_ReadModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFO_ReadAccepted
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NFO_ReadModel

theorem accepted {Key : Type} [DecidableEq Key] (selected : Key)
    (cpi : core.result.Result Unit AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError)
    (returned : Option (Key × Bytes))
    (decode : Bytes → Result (core.result.Result Output DecodeError))
    (value : Accepted) (events : List Event)
    (success : run selected cpi returned decode = ok (.Ok value,events)) :
    cpi = .Ok () ∧ ∃ bytes,
      returned = some (selected,bytes) ∧ bytes.length = 792 ∧
      decode bytes = ok (.Ok value.value) ∧ value.bytes = bytes ∧
      events = [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode] := by
  cases cpi with
  | Err e => cases success
  | Ok unit =>
    cases unit
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    cases returned with
    | none => cases success
    | some pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨program,bytes⟩
      by_cases hp : program ≠ selected
      · simp only [run, if_pos hp] at success
        cases success
      · have heq : program = selected := not_not.mp hp
        subst program
        by_cases hl : bytes.length ≠ 792
        · simp only [run, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, if_pos hl] at success
          cases success
        · have width : bytes.length = 792 := not_not.mp hl
          simp only [run, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, if_false, width] at success
          cases hd : decode bytes with
          | fail e => simp only [hd, bind_tc_fail] at success; cases success
          | div => simp only [hd, bind_tc_div] at success; cases success
          | ok decoded =>
            cases decoded with
            | Err e => simp only [hd, bind_tc_ok] at success; cases success
            | Ok output =>
              simp only [hd, bind_tc_ok] at success
              have pairEq := Result.ok.inj success
              have recEq := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (congrArg Prod.fst pairEq)
              have eventsEq := congrArg Prod.snd pairEq
              exact ⟨bytes,rfl,width,by rw [← recEq]; exact hd,
                congrArg Accepted.bytes recEq.symm,eventsEq.symm⟩
#print axioms accepted
end NFO_ReadAccepted

theorem uniform {A B : Type} (encode : A → List B) (width : Nat)
    (positive : 0 < width) (size : ∀ a, (encode a).length = width)
    (injective : Function.Injective encode) :
    Function.Injective (fun xs : List A => xs.flatMap encode) := by
  have take_word (a : A) : (encode a).take width = encode a :=
    List.take_of_length_le (by rw [size])
  intro xs ys same
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b tail =>
      have lengths := congrArg List.length same
      simp only [List.flatMap_nil,List.flatMap_cons,List.length_append,List.length_nil,size] at lengths
      omega
  | cons a tail ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      have lengths := congrArg List.length same
      simp only [List.flatMap_nil,List.flatMap_cons,List.length_append,List.length_nil,size] at lengths
      omega
    | cons b rest =>
      have head := congrArg (List.take width) same
      have words : encode a = encode b := by
        simpa [List.flatMap_cons,List.take_append,size,take_word] using head
      have ab := injective words
      subst b
      have dropped := congrArg (List.drop width) same
      have tails : tail.flatMap encode = rest.flatMap encode := by
        simpa [List.flatMap_cons,List.drop_append,size] using dropped
      rw [ih tails]

/-- OPEN codec obligation at exactly the domain proved by the Pool gate.
This is accepted decoding/encoding inversion, not decoder totality or a
native/refinement assumption hidden in a carrier. -/
def AcceptedCodec : Prop :=
  ∀ bytes value, bytes.length = 792 →
    NFO_PacketDecoder.run bytes = ok (.Ok value) →
    (NFO_ResultLayout.bytes value).val = bytes

/-- Accepted-run MODEL association. The remaining codec premise is explicit.
The full native Pool carrier/ownership certificate is independently required
before this conditional mathematical fact receives hybrid closure credit. -/
theorem consumed {Context Key State : Type} [DecidableEq Key]
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key State) (law : RuntimeReturnData runtime)
    (codec : AcceptedCodec) (context : Context) (selected : Key)
    (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement) (value : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted)
    (events : List NFO_ReadModel.Event)
    (accepted : NFO_ReadModel.run selected (.Ok ())
      (runtime.read context (runtime.write context selected
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) NFO_PacketDecoder.run =
      ok (.Ok value,events)) :
    value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s ∧
    value.bytes = (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val ∧
    events = [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode] := by
  have width := (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).property
  have read := law context selected (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val (by rw [width]; decide)
  rw [read] at accepted
  obtain ⟨_,bytes,returned,length,decoded,saved,trace⟩ :=
    NFO_ReadAccepted.accepted selected (.Ok ()) _ NFO_PacketDecoder.run value events accepted
  have pairEq := Option.some.inj returned
  have bytesEq := congrArg Prod.snd pairEq
  have encoded := codec bytes value.value length decoded
  have encodedArray : NFO_ResultLayout.bytes value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s :=
    Subtype.ext (encoded.trans bytesEq.symm)
  have same : value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s :=
    NFO_ResultInjective.injective _ _ (encodedArray.trans (NFO_ResultLayout.emitted s).symm)
  exact ⟨same,saved.trans bytesEq.symm,trace⟩

end NFO_AcceptedAssociation

import NFO_AcceptedAssociation
import NFO_ResultLayout
import NEY_EmitComposed
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFR_CSettlement
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Output := NEU_EmitModel.Output
abbrev Bytes := Array U8 792#usize
abbrev Error := AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError
abbrev EncodeError := NEU_EmitModel.Error

/-- The deployed Pool error discriminant, not the verifier's generic error. -/
def invalidReturn : Error := .Custom 0x4153202D#u32

inductive Call where
  | validate (value : Output)
  | lane (value : Output)
  | encode (value : Output)

/-- The post-verifier settlement cut. Full child Results are retained; lane
images are arbitrary typed values. It is not the enclosing Pool process. -/
def run {LaneImage : Type}
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes EncodeError))
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) :
    Result (core.result.Result (LaneImage × Bytes) Error × List Call) := do
  let result := authenticated.value
  let checked ← validate result
  match checked with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e,[.validate result])
  | .Ok () =>
    let image ← lane result
    match image with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e,[.validate result,.lane result])
    | .Ok image =>
      let encoded ← encode result
      match encoded with
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err invalidReturn,[.validate result,.lane result,.encode result])
      | .Ok bytes => ok (.Ok (image,bytes),[.validate result,.lane result,.encode result])

theorem success {LaneImage : Type}
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes EncodeError))
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) (image : LaneImage) (bytes : Bytes)
    (checked : validate authenticated.value = ok (.Ok ()))
    (advanced : lane authenticated.value = ok (.Ok image))
    (encoded : encode authenticated.value = ok (.Ok bytes)) :
    run validate lane encode authenticated =
      ok (.Ok (image,bytes),[.validate authenticated.value,.lane authenticated.value,
        .encode authenticated.value]) := by
  simp only [run,checked,advanced,encoded,bind_tc_ok]

theorem rejected_validation {LaneImage : Type}
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes EncodeError))
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) (e : Error)
    (rejected : validate authenticated.value = ok (.Err e)) :
    run validate lane encode authenticated = ok (.Err e,[.validate authenticated.value]) := by
  simp only [run,rejected,bind_tc_ok]

theorem rejected_lane {LaneImage : Type}
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes EncodeError))
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) (e : Error)
    (checked : validate authenticated.value = ok (.Ok ()))
    (rejected : lane authenticated.value = ok (.Err e)) :
    run validate lane encode authenticated =
      ok (.Err e,[.validate authenticated.value,.lane authenticated.value]) := by
  simp only [run,checked,rejected,bind_tc_ok]

theorem rejected_encoder {LaneImage : Type}
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes EncodeError))
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) (image : LaneImage) (e : EncodeError)
    (checked : validate authenticated.value = ok (.Ok ()))
    (advanced : lane authenticated.value = ok (.Ok image))
    (rejected : encode authenticated.value = ok (.Err e)) :
    run validate lane encode authenticated =
      ok (.Err invalidReturn,[.validate authenticated.value,.lane authenticated.value,
        .encode authenticated.value]) := by
  simp only [run,checked,advanced,rejected,bind_tc_ok]

/-- Once the accepted decoder identifies the SAME emitted value, the CLOSED
encoder bridge's domain follows from the original statement validation. No
independent encoder-domain assumption is added at this call edge. -/
theorem reencode_same (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement)
    (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted)
    (same : authenticated.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s)
    (valid : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    NEY_EmitComposed.encode authenticated.value =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) := by
  rw [same,NEY_EmitComposed.encoder_bridge s]
  exact AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.encoded s valid

#print axioms success
#print axioms rejected_validation
#print axioms rejected_lane
#print axioms rejected_encoder
#print axioms reencode_same
end NFR_CSettlement

theorem accepted_bytes (bytes : Slice U8) (value : Output)
    (accepted : NFO_RawDecode.decode bytes = ok (.Ok value)) :
    (NFO_ResultLayout.bytes value).val = bytes.val := by
  have spec := NFR_RawInverseFrames.frames bytes
  rw [accepted,WP.spec_ok] at spec
  obtain ⟨width,magic,h4,h5,h6,h7,master,selected,digest,afterstate⟩ := spec value rfl
  have e4 : bytes.val[4]'(by omega) = 1#u8 := by
    have lookup : bytes.val[4]? = some (bytes.val[4]'(by omega)) := List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    exact Option.some.inj (lookup.symm.trans h4)
  have e5 : bytes.val[5]'(by omega) = kind value.transition_kind := by
    have lookup : bytes.val[5]? = some (bytes.val[5]'(by omega)) := List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    exact Option.some.inj (lookup.symm.trans h5)
  have e6 : bytes.val[6]'(by omega) = 1#u8 := by
    have lookup : bytes.val[6]? = some (bytes.val[6]'(by omega)) := List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    exact Option.some.inj (lookup.symm.trans h6)
  have e7 : bytes.val[7]'(by omega) = value.output_lane := by
    have lookup : bytes.val[7]? = some (bytes.val[7]'(by omega)) := List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)
    exact Option.some.inj (lookup.symm.trans h7)
  have header :
      [65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8,1#u8,kind value.transition_kind,1#u8,value.output_lane] =
      bytes.val.take 8 := by
    rw [AspisS6SliceFrame.header_eight bytes.val (by omega),magic,e4,e5,e6,e7]
    rfl
  unfold NFO_ResultLayout.bytes
  rw [stores_layout,header,master,selected,digest,afterstate]
  rw [AspisS6SliceFrame.take_append_slice bytes.val 8 40 (by decide),
    AspisS6SliceFrame.take_append_slice bytes.val 40 72 (by decide),
    AspisS6SliceFrame.take_append_slice bytes.val 72 104 (by decide)]
  exact List.take_append_drop 104 bytes.val

  intro bytes value accepted
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact accepted_bytes (Array.to_slice bytes) value accepted
#print axioms raw_inverse

  NFO_Final.codec_iff_raw.mpr raw_inverse

import NFR_RawInverse
import NFR_ResultForward
import NFR_CHelperBridge
import NFR_CSettlement
import NFR_ExtractedDecode
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFR_PoolReturnData
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open NFO_PoolReturnData
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal

/-- Ruling (ab'): the accepted runtime row is only about nonempty replies.
The Context parameter is identical at write and read, with no intervening state. -/
def RuntimeReturnData {Context Key State : Type}
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key State) : Prop :=
  ∀ context program bytes, 1 ≤ bytes.length → bytes.length ≤ 1024 →
    runtime.read context (runtime.write context program bytes) = some (program,bytes)

/-- Accepted-run composition: acceptance is the event being analysed, not a
new runtime or codec premise. Decoder inversion is proved by raw_inverse. -/
theorem accepted_association {Context Key RuntimeState Accounts Other : Type} [DecidableEq Key]
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key RuntimeState) (law : RuntimeReturnData runtime)
    (context : Context) (selected : Key)
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State Accounts Other) (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement)
    (valid : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ()))
    (value : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted) (events : List NFO_ReadModel.Event)
    (accepted : NFO_ReadModel.run selected (.Ok ())
      (runtime.read context (runtime.write context selected
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) NFO_PacketDecoder.run =
      ok (.Ok value,events)) :
    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes))
      state s = ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set state
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) ∧
    value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s ∧
    value.bytes = (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val ∧
    (NFO_ResultLayout.bytes value.value).val = value.bytes ∧
    events = [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode] ∧
    NEY_EmitComposed.encode value.value =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) ∧
    NFR_CHelper.terminal_ref NEY_EmitComposed.encode value.value =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) := by
  have width := (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).property
  have read := law context selected (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val
    (by rw [width]; decide) (by rw [width]; decide)
  rw [read] at accepted
  obtain ⟨_,bytes,returned,length,decoded,saved,trace⟩ :=
    NFO_ReadAccepted.accepted selected (.Ok ()) _ NFO_PacketDecoder.run value events accepted
  have pairEq := Option.some.inj returned
  have bytesEq := congrArg Prod.snd pairEq
  have encoded := NFR_RawInverse.accepted_codec bytes value.value length decoded
  have encodedArray : NFO_ResultLayout.bytes value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s :=
    Subtype.ext (encoded.trans bytesEq.symm)
  have same : value.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s :=
    NFO_ResultInjective.injective _ _ (encodedArray.trans (NFO_ResultLayout.emitted s).symm)
  exact ⟨AspisR1.JHb_Emit.accepted _ (fun _ _ => rfl) state s valid,
    same,saved.trans bytesEq.symm,encoded.trans saved.symm,trace,
    NFR_CSettlement.reencode_same s value same valid,
    NFR_CHelperBridge.same_emission s value same valid⟩
#print axioms accepted_association
/-- Forward association: the decoder's accepting return is derived for every
valid emitted statement. There is no independent accepted-read premise. -/
theorem association {Context Key RuntimeState Accounts Other : Type} [DecidableEq Key]
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key RuntimeState) (law : RuntimeReturnData runtime)
    (context : Context) (selected : Key)
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State Accounts Other) (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement)
    (valid : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes))
      state s = ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set state
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) ∧
    NFO_ReadModel.run selected (.Ok ())
      (runtime.read context (runtime.write context selected
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) NFO_PacketDecoder.run =
      ok (.Ok ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,
          (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩,
        [.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode]) ∧
    NEY_EmitComposed.encode (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s) =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) ∧
    NFR_CHelper.terminal_ref NEY_EmitComposed.encode
      (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s) =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) := by
  have width := (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).property
  refine ⟨AspisR1.JHb_Emit.accepted _ (fun _ _ => rfl) state s valid,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [law context selected _ (by rw [width]; decide) (by rw [width]; decide)]
    exact NFO_ReadModel.decoded selected _ NFO_PacketDecoder.run _ width
      (NFR_ResultForward.emitted s valid)
  · exact NFR_CSettlement.reencode_same s
      ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,(AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩ rfl valid
  · exact NFR_CHelperBridge.same_emission s
      ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,(AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩ rfl valid
#print axioms association
end NFR_PoolReturnData

Only validation/lane success remain, on this very decoded statement value. -/
theorem same_emitted_settlement {Context Key RuntimeState Accounts Other LaneImage : Type}
    [DecidableEq Key]
    (runtime : Runtime Context Key RuntimeState) (law : NFR_PoolReturnData.RuntimeReturnData runtime)
    (context : Context) (selected : Key)
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State Accounts Other) (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement)
    (valid : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ()))
    (validate : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit PoolError))
    (lane : Output → Result (core.result.Result LaneImage PoolError)) (image : LaneImage)
    (checked : validate (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s) = ok (.Ok ()))
    (advanced : lane (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s) = ok (.Ok image)) :
    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes)) state s =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set state (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val)) ∧
    NFO_ReadModel.run selected (.Ok ())
      (runtime.read context (runtime.write context selected (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val))
      NFO_PacketDecoder.run = ok (.Ok ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,
        (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩,[.clear,.invoke,.read,.decode]) ∧
    NFR_CSettlement.run validate lane NEY_EmitComposed.encode
      ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,(AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩ =
      ok (.Ok (image,AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s),
        [.validate (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s),
         .lane (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s),
         .encode (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s)]) := by
  have linked := NFR_PoolReturnData.association runtime law context selected state s valid
  refine ⟨linked.1,linked.2.1,?_⟩
  exact NFR_CSettlement.success validate lane NEY_EmitComposed.encode
    ⟨AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s,(AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s).val⟩
    image (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s) checked advanced linked.2.2.1
#print axioms same_emitted_settlement

/-- Explicit local interpretation witnessing consistency of the nonempty row;
it is not an implementation proof about a Solana validator. Empty returns None. -/
def localRuntime (Context Key : Type) [DecidableEq Context] :
    Runtime Context Key (Context × Key × List U8) where
  write context key bytes := (context,key,bytes)
  read context state := if context = state.1 then
    if state.2.2.length = 0 then none else some (state.2.1,state.2.2) else none

theorem local_law (Context Key : Type) [DecidableEq Context] :
    NFR_PoolReturnData.RuntimeReturnData (localRuntime Context Key) := by
  intro context key bytes positive _bounded
  have nonzero : bytes.length ≠ 0 := by omega
  simp only [localRuntime,ite_true,nonzero,ite_false]
#print axioms local_law

theorem local_empty (Context Key : Type) [DecidableEq Context] (context : Context) (key : Key) :
    (localRuntime Context Key).read context ((localRuntime Context Key).write context key []) = none := by
  simp only [localRuntime,ite_true,List.length_nil]
#print axioms local_empty
end NFR_ModelJoin

def readonly {Key : Type} (key : Key) : Meta Key := ⟨key,false,false⟩
def metas {Key : Type} (proof master checkpoint lane registry entry verifierCheckpoint : Key) :=
  [readonly proof,readonly master,readonly checkpoint,readonly lane,readonly registry,
   readonly entry] ++ [readonly verifierCheckpoint]

    (metas proof master checkpoint lane registry entry cp).map Meta.key =
      [proof,master,checkpoint,lane,registry,entry,cp] := by rfl

    (m : Meta Key) (present : m ∈ metas proof master checkpoint lane registry entry cp) :
    m.signer = false ∧ m.writable = false := by
  simp [metas] at present
  rcases present with h|h|h|h|h|h|h <;> subst m <;> exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
#print axioms flags

This is a list value law; native Vec realization is separately classified. -/

  [proof,master,checkpoint,lane,registry,entry] ++ [cp,program]

theorem range {N M : Usize} (a : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize) (src : Array U8 M)

    (width : stop.val - start.val = M.val) :

        (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
        a {start:=start, «end»:=stop}
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part src.to_slice
      ok (back copied)) = ok (write a start src) := by
  have fit : M.val ≤ N.val - start.val := by omega
  simp only [core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,

    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut]

theorem bind_pair_finish {A B C D E : Type} (r : Result (A × B))
    (f : A → B → Result C) (g : A → B → C → D) (k : D → Result E) :
    ((do let (a,b) ← r; let c ← f a b; ok (g a b c)) >>= k) =

namespace NFV_Envelope

abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Payment := Array U8 216#usize
abbrev Bytes := Array U8 320#usize

def headerBytes (kind : U8) : List U8 :=
  [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8,1#u8,kind,1#u8,0#u8]

def header (kind : U8) : Bytes :=
  let magic := write (Array.repeat 320#usize 0#u8) 0#usize POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC
  let version := updateValue magic 4#usize POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
  let tag := updateValue version 5#usize kind
  updateValue tag 6#usize AspisR20Request.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION

def pure (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment) : Bytes :=
  write (write (write (write (header kind) 8#usize profile) 40#usize release) 72#usize program) 104#usize payment

def paymentStage (payment : Payment) (a : Bytes) : Result Bytes := do
  let (part, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8)) a {start:=104#usize}
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part payment.to_slice
  ok (back copied)
def programStage (program : Bytes32) (payment : Payment) (a : Bytes) : Result Bytes := do
  let (part, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)) a {start:=72#usize,«end»:=104#usize}
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part program.to_slice
  paymentStage payment (back copied)
def releaseStage (release program : Bytes32) (payment : Payment) (a : Bytes) : Result Bytes := do
  let (part, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)) a {start:=40#usize,«end»:=72#usize}
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part release.to_slice
  programStage program payment (back copied)
def profileStage (profile release program : Bytes32) (payment : Payment) (a : Bytes) : Result Bytes := do
  let (part, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)) a {start:=8#usize,«end»:=40#usize}
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part profile.to_slice
  releaseStage release program payment (back copied)
def headerStage (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment) (a : Bytes) : Result Bytes := do
  let a ← a.update 4#usize POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
  let a ← a.update 5#usize kind
  let a ← a.update 6#usize AspisR20Request.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
  profileStage profile release program payment a

/-- Compose the symbolic window laws with explicit continuations. -/
theorem emitted (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment) :
    asq8_reference_envelope profile release program kind payment =
      ok (pure profile release program kind payment) := by
  let initial := Array.repeat 320#usize 0#u8
  unfold asq8_reference_envelope
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,REQUEST_PROFILE_OFFSET,REQUEST_RELEASE_OFFSET,REQUEST_POOL_PROGRAM_OFFSET,REQUEST_PAYMENT_OFFSET]
  change (do
    let (part,back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8)) initial {«end»:=4#usize}
    let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 part POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC.to_slice
    headerStage profile release program kind payment (back copied)) = _
  erw [prefix_then initial POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC (by decide)
      (headerStage profile release program kind payment)]
  unfold headerStage
  erw [update _ 4#usize _ (by decide),bind_tc_ok,
    update _ 5#usize _ (by decide),bind_tc_ok,
    update _ 6#usize _ (by decide),bind_tc_ok]
  unfold profileStage
  erw [range_then _ 8#usize 40#usize profile (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (releaseStage release program payment)]
  unfold releaseStage
  erw [range_then _ 40#usize 72#usize release (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (programStage program payment)]
  unfold programStage
  erw [range_then _ 72#usize 104#usize program (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    (paymentStage payment)]
  unfold paymentStage
  erw [suffix _ 104#usize payment (by decide) (by decide)]
  rfl
#print axioms emitted
theorem header_value (kind : U8) :
    (header kind).val = headerBytes kind ++ List.replicate 312 0#u8 := by
  simp only [header,write,updateValue,Array.repeat,Array.make,
    POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC,POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION,
    AspisR20Request.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION]
  change ((((List.replicate 320 0#u8).setSlice! 0 [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8]).set 4 1#u8).set 5 kind).set 6 1#u8 = _
  have first := NFV_ListFrames.copy_next ([] : List U8) [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8] 0#u8 320 (by decide)
  simp only [List.nil_append,List.length_nil] at first
  rw [first]
  change ((([65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8] ++ List.replicate 316 0#u8).set 4 1#u8).set 5 kind).set 6 1#u8 = _
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  have next4 := NFV_ListFrames.set_next [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8] (List.replicate 315 0#u8) 0#u8 1#u8
  simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at next4
  rw [next4]
  change (([65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8,1#u8] ++ List.replicate 315 0#u8).set 5 kind).set 6 1#u8 = _
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  have next5 := NFV_ListFrames.set_next [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8,1#u8] (List.replicate 314 0#u8) 0#u8 kind
  simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at next5
  rw [next5]
  change ([65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8,1#u8,kind] ++ List.replicate 314 0#u8).set 6 1#u8 = _
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  have next6 := NFV_ListFrames.set_next [65#u8,83#u8,81#u8,56#u8,1#u8,kind] (List.replicate 313 0#u8) 0#u8 1#u8
  simp only [List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at next6
  rw [next6]
  rw [List.replicate_succ]
  rfl
#print axioms header_value

theorem pure_value (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val =
      headerBytes kind ++ profile.val ++ release.val ++ program.val ++ payment.val := by
  unfold pure write
  change ((((header kind).val.setSlice! 8 profile.val).setSlice! 40 release.val).setSlice! 72 program.val).setSlice! 104 payment.val = _
  rw [header_value]
  rw [NFV_ListFrames.copy_at (headerBytes kind) profile.val 0#u8 312 8 (by simp [headerBytes]) (by simp [profile.property])]
  simp only [profile.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl]
  rw [NFV_ListFrames.copy_at (headerBytes kind ++ profile.val) release.val 0#u8 280 40 (by simp [headerBytes,profile.property]) (by simp [release.property])]

  rw [NFV_ListFrames.copy_at (headerBytes kind ++ profile.val ++ release.val) program.val 0#u8 248 72 (by simp [headerBytes,profile.property,release.property]) (by simp [program.property])]
  simp only [program.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl]

import NFR_CHelperBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFV_HelperModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Output := NEU_EmitModel.Output
abbrev Bytes := NFR_CHelperBridge.Bytes
abbrev Error := NFR_CHelperBridge.EncodeError
abbrev ProgramError := NFR_CHelperBridge.ProgramError
inductive Call where
  | encode (value : Output)
  | allocate (bytes : Bytes)

def run (encoder : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error)) (r : Output) :
    Result (core.result.Result Bytes ProgramError × List Call) := do
  let answer ← encoder r
  match answer with
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err NFR_CSettlement.invalidReturn,[.encode r])
  | .Ok bytes => ok (.Ok bytes,[.encode r,.allocate bytes])

theorem success (encoder : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error))
    (r : Output) (bytes : Bytes) (encoded : encoder r = ok (.Ok bytes)) :
    run encoder r = ok (.Ok bytes,[.encode r,.allocate bytes]) := by
  simp only [run,encoded,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms success

theorem rejected (encoder : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error))
    (r : Output) (error : Error) (encoded : encoder r = ok (.Err error)) :
    run encoder r = ok (.Err NFR_CSettlement.invalidReturn,[.encode r]) := by
  simp only [run,encoded,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms rejected

/-- Ghost call observations erase to the already extracted helper semantics;
allocation remains present in the observation trace, and errors allocate nothing. -/
theorem erase (encoder : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error)) (r : Output) :
    (do let observed ← run encoder r; ok observed.1) =
      NFR_CHelper.terminal_ref encoder r := by
  rw [NFR_CHelperBridge.semantic]
  cases h : encoder r with
  | fail e => simp only [run,NFR_CHelperBridge.run,h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [run,NFR_CHelperBridge.run,h,bind_tc_div]
  | ok answer =>
    cases answer <;> simp only [run,NFR_CHelperBridge.run,h,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms erase

/-- The original validated statement discharges the CLOSED encoder's domain on
this same authenticated value, without an extra encoder-domain hypothesis. -/
theorem same_emission (s : NEU_EmitModel.Statement) (authenticated : NFO_ReadModel.Accepted)
    (same : authenticated.value = AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s)
    (valid : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    run NEY_EmitComposed.encode authenticated.value =
      ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s),
        [.encode authenticated.value,.allocate (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)]) := by
  exact success _ _ _ (NFR_CSettlement.reencode_same s authenticated same valid)
#print axioms same_emission
end NFV_HelperModel

import NFV_Envelope
import NED_WindowExtensionality
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFV_RequestWindows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Bytes := NFV_Envelope.Bytes

def point (a b : Bytes) (i : Fin (320#usize).val) : Prop :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by rw [a.property]; exact i.isLt) =
  b.val[i.val]'(by rw [b.property]; exact i.isLt)

/-- Five arbitrary-index native observations cover the entire request. This
lemma composes observations that must each be supplied by a native certificate. -/
theorem complete (actual expected : Bytes)
    (header : ∀ i, i.val < 8 → point actual expected i)
    (profile : ∀ i, 8 ≤ i.val → i.val < 40 → point actual expected i)
    (release : ∀ i, 40 ≤ i.val → i.val < 72 → point actual expected i)
    (program : ∀ i, 72 ≤ i.val → i.val < 104 → point actual expected i)
    (payment : ∀ i, 104 ≤ i.val → point actual expected i) : actual = expected := by
  apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
  intro i
  by_cases h0 : i.val < 8
  · exact header i h0
  by_cases h1 : i.val < 40
  · exact profile i (by omega) h1
  by_cases h2 : i.val < 72
  · exact release i (by omega) h2
  by_cases h3 : i.val < 104
  · exact program i (by omega) h3
  exact payment i (by omega)
#print axioms complete

/-- The emitted envelope can be replaced only AFTER all five native windows
have supplied their observations on the SAME returned array. -/
theorem envelope (actual : Bytes) (profile release program : NFV_Envelope.Bytes32)
    (kind : U8) (payment : NFV_Envelope.Payment)
    (header : ∀ i, i.val < 8 → point actual (NFV_Envelope.pure profile release program kind payment) i)
    (hp : ∀ i, 8 ≤ i.val → i.val < 40 → point actual (NFV_Envelope.pure profile release program kind payment) i)
    (hr : ∀ i, 40 ≤ i.val → i.val < 72 → point actual (NFV_Envelope.pure profile release program kind payment) i)
    (hb : ∀ i, 72 ≤ i.val → i.val < 104 → point actual (NFV_Envelope.pure profile release program kind payment) i)
    (ht : ∀ i, 104 ≤ i.val → point actual (NFV_Envelope.pure profile release program kind payment) i) :
    AspisR20Request.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.asq8_reference_envelope
      profile release program kind payment = ok actual := by
  rw [NFV_Envelope.emitted,complete actual _ header hp hr hb ht]
#print axioms envelope
end NFV_RequestWindows

def run
  (transfer : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 → Result (core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 216#usize) pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
  (withdrawal : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 → Result (core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 216#usize) pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
  (request : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 320#usize)
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
  := do
  let a := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
  let b ←
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      request.verifier_profile a
  if b
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
  else
    let a1 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
    let b1 ←
      core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8
        request.verifier_release a1
    if b1
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
    else
      let a2 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
      let b2 ←
        core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8
          request.pool_program a2
      if b2
      then
        ok (core.result.Result.Err
          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
      else
        match request.«public» with
        |
          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalPaymentV1.PrivateTransfer
          public1 =>
          let r ←
            transfer public1
          let r1 ←
            core.result.Result.map_err

              r ()

          match cf with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
            let i ← 1#u8 + 0#u8
            let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i)
            let a3 ←
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.asq8_reference_envelope
                request.verifier_profile request.verifier_release
                request.pool_program i1 val
            ok (core.result.Result.Ok a3)
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              (Array Std.U8 320#usize) (core.convert.FromSame
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
              residual
        |
          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalPaymentV1.Withdrawal
          public1 =>
          let r ←
            withdrawal public1
          let r1 ←
            core.result.Result.map_err
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PaymentStatementFormatErrorPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
              r ()
          let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
          match cf with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
            let i ← 2#u8 + 0#u8
            let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i)
            let a3 ←
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.asq8_reference_envelope
                request.verifier_profile request.verifier_release
                request.pool_program i1 val
            ok (core.result.Result.Ok a3)
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              (Array Std.U8 320#usize) (core.convert.FromSame
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
              residual

/-- Value erasure of the two typed child oracles is the adopted emitted caller.
Native call-log correctness and child domains are separate obligations. -/
theorem erase (request : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1) :
    run pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.asq8_payment_reference.encode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.asq8_payment_reference.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 request =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1 request := by rfl
#print axioms erase

/-- Rejection precedes both payment calls, for the exact emitted guard. -/
theorem profile_rejected
    (transfer : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
    (withdrawal : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
    (request : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1)

    run transfer withdrawal request = ok (.Err pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding) := by

  dsimp only

import NFV_RequestOracle

namespace NFV_RequestIndexes
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std NFV_Envelope

theorem window {T : Type} (before part after : List T) (start i : Nat)
    (position : before.length = start) (inside : start ≤ i) (bound : i-start < part.length) :
    (before ++ part ++ after)[i]? = part[i-start]? := by
  rw [List.append_assoc,List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
  rw [position,List.getElem?_append_left bound]
#print axioms window

theorem header (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment)
    (j : Nat) (bounded : j < 8) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val[j]? = (headerBytes kind)[j]? := by
  rw [pure_value]
  simpa only [List.nil_append,List.append_assoc,Nat.sub_zero] using
    window [] (headerBytes kind) (profile.val ++ release.val ++ program.val ++ payment.val) 0 j rfl
      (Nat.zero_le j) (by simpa [headerBytes] using bounded)
#print axioms header

theorem profile (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment)
    (j : Nat) (lower : 8 ≤ j) (upper : j < 40) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val[j]? = profile.val[j-8]? := by
  have hp : profile.val.length = 32 := profile.property
  rw [pure_value]
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    window (headerBytes kind) profile.val (release.val ++ program.val ++ payment.val) 8 j
      (by simp [headerBytes]) lower (by omega)
#print axioms profile

theorem release (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment)
    (j : Nat) (lower : 40 ≤ j) (upper : j < 72) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val[j]? = release.val[j-40]? := by
  have hp : profile.val.length = 32 := profile.property
  have hr : release.val.length = 32 := release.property
  rw [pure_value]
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    window (headerBytes kind ++ profile.val) release.val (program.val ++ payment.val) 40 j
      (by simp [headerBytes,hp]) lower (by omega)
#print axioms release

theorem program (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment)
    (j : Nat) (lower : 72 ≤ j) (upper : j < 104) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val[j]? = program.val[j-72]? := by
  have hp : profile.val.length = 32 := profile.property
  have hr : release.val.length = 32 := release.property
  have hb : program.val.length = 32 := program.property
  rw [pure_value]
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    window (headerBytes kind ++ profile.val ++ release.val) program.val payment.val 72 j
      (by simp [headerBytes,hp,hr]) lower (by omega)
#print axioms program

theorem payment (profile release program : Bytes32) (kind : U8) (payment : Payment)
    (j : Nat) (lower : 104 ≤ j) (upper : j < 320) :
    (pure profile release program kind payment).val[j]? = payment.val[j-104]? := by
  have hp : profile.val.length = 32 := profile.property
  have hr : release.val.length = 32 := release.property
  have hb : program.val.length = 32 := program.property
  have ht : payment.val.length = 216 := payment.property
  rw [pure_value]
  simpa only [List.append_nil,List.append_assoc] using
    window (headerBytes kind ++ profile.val ++ release.val ++ program.val) payment.val [] 104 j
      (by simp [headerBytes,hp,hr,hb]) lower (by omega)
#print axioms payment
end NFV_RequestIndexes

import NFV_RequestIndexes
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFV_RequestGuards
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def compare (p : U8 × U8) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← core.cmp.PartialEqU8.ne p.1 p.2
  ok (decide (¬b = true))

theorem lists (xs ys : List U8) (same : xs.length = ys.length) :
    List.allM compare (xs.zip ys) = ok (decide (xs = ys)) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys => simp at same
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp at same
    | cons y ys =>
      have tail : xs.length = ys.length := by simpa using same
      by_cases equal : x = y
      · subst y
        simp [List.allM,compare,core.cmp.PartialEqU8,liftFun2,
          core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne,ih ys tail]
      · have unequal : x.val ≠ y.val := fun eq => equal (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq eq)
        simp [List.allM,compare,core.cmp.PartialEqU8,liftFun2,
          core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne,ih ys tail,equal,unequal]
        rfl
#print axioms lists

theorem array {N : Usize} (a b : Array U8 N) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a b = ok (decide (a.val = b.val)) := by
  have lengths : a.val.length = b.val.length := by rw [a.property,b.property]
  simp only [core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq,Array.length,a.property,b.property,ite_true]
  change List.allM compare (a.val.zip b.val) = _
  rw [lists a.val b.val lengths]
#print axioms array
theorem zero_binding {N : Usize} (a : Array U8 N) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a (Array.repeat N 0#u8) =
      ok (decide (a.val = List.replicate N.val 0#u8)) := by
  simpa only [Array.repeat_val] using array a (Array.repeat N 0#u8)
#print axioms zero_binding
end NFV_RequestGuards
